text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup, where Mihono 
Bourbon and Tokai Teio would clash. The 
venue was engulfed in wild excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio reveals to Mihono Bourbon that 
she had actually felt anxiety through her 
repeated injuries and comebacks, and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She speaks of how watching Mihono 
Bourbon's performance in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) helped her rediscover the pure 
joy of competition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tokai Teio's powerful figure, 
Mihono Bourbon, just like Rice Shower, 
felt the urge to "catch up to her."
